notes.framing: Exactly one compact JSON object per line (json.dumps separators=(',', ':')), every line terminated by \n including the last. Plan section 2.1, S-2-3.
notes.line_1: type=transcript. trace.stt_ms times the transcribe await only; trace.upload_bytes is len( content ). Both diagnostic: the phone reads transcription and ignores trace.
notes.line_2: type=ask. result is the full AskResponse body /api/v2/ask returns: every field, in the model's declared order, nulls included. The phone parses it with AskResponse.fromJson (routeReason and traceId required).
notes.error: When flow.ask raises after line 1, line 2 is instead {"type":"error","stage":"ask","detail":"<message>"}. Not part of this body.
